This matter will be treated as closed without future proceedings on this account.

articles.title: India refused illegal migrants as UK didn't extradite Nirav Modi: Priti Patel
articles.description: Former UK Home Secretary Priti Patel stated India refused migrant returns. This refusal was linked to the UK's failure to extradite fugitive jeweler Nirav Modi. Patel expressed dismay that Modi remained in London for seven years. She believes India was angry over Britain's stance on his extradition. India has denied opposing the return of illegal migrants.

articles.title: 'Can't bribe them': Trump's 'will beat them' warning to Iran despite talks
articles.description: Despite Trump's remarks, tensions remained high across the region. Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq reported drone attacks on Monday, suggesting that hostilities had not completely subsided despite the pause in the US bombing campaign. Washington halted its two-week air campaign against Iran on Saturday in a surprise policy shift by Trump after nearly five months of conflict. Iran said it had not abandoned diplomacy but denied reports that it had sought talks with Washington.

articles.title: 'Could result in injuries': FAA flags incorrectly installed seats on several Boeing 737 Max jets
articles.description: The FAA has proposed mandatory inspections for 453 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft seats. Improperly installed seat assemblies could disengage during turbulence or emergency landings. This condition might injure passengers and crew or block the evacuation aisle. Boeing supports the FAA's decision to make these recommendations mandatory. The directive applies to US-registered aircraft, with no deadline specified yet.

articles.title: French wildfire created a monster cloud, unleashing lightning that ignited more fires
articles.description: A powerful wildfire in France generated its own thunderstorm, creating new fires. This rare pyrocumulonimbus phenomenon produced violent winds that drove the flames unpredictably. The blaze near Saumos burned over 420 square kilometers and forced many evacuations. This event marks the first recorded instance of such a storm in France. Scientists are studying these extreme fire events and their connection to climate change.

articles.title: Keigo Higashino, author of 'The Devotion of Suspect X', dies at 68
articles.description: Japanese mystery author Keigo Higashino has died at age sixty-eight. His publisher announced his passing on Monday, which caused widespread grief. Higashino wrote over one hundred books, translated into many languages worldwide. His works were adapted for film and television, gaining him a large following. He was known for merging science and detective fiction with human observations.

articles.title: US firms training AI using Chinese examples: Beijing
articles.description: China's commerce ministry accused American artificial intelligence firms of using Chinese models. This statement follows recent US threats of sanctions against Chinese technology companies. Beijing stated that many US AI companies distilled Chinese models during their development processes. The ministry defended distillation as a common industry practice while criticizing US actions. China vowed to take necessary measures to protect its own economic interests.

articles.title: Rupee surges 66 paise on RBI governor's remark, sensex up 776 points
articles.description: The rupee strengthened significantly against the US dollar on Monday. RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated the domestic currency was undervalued. Indian stock markets also saw a substantial jump, ending their losing streak.

articles.description: The government has allowed the Reserve Bank of India to print two billion polymer notes. These new polymer notes will be printed for field trials and regular issuance. articles.title: UP PCS 2026 application deadline extended to August 3 for 500 vacancies; check details and direct link here
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission has extended the last date to apply for the UP PCS 2026 recruitment examination to August 3. The recruitment drive aims to fill 500 vacancies through the Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services Examination-2026. Applicants must complete the One Time Registration process before applying online. The selection process includes preliminary and main examinations, an interview, document verification and a medical examination. Application correction will remain available until August 10.

articles.title: Ariana Grande files complaint against hackers for leaking unreleased content
articles.description: Pop superstar Ariana Grande has taken legal action against over one hundred individuals following a serious breach of privacy. Hackers accessed her private photographs and unreleased music, later selling them for significant sums on the dark web. Through this lawsuit, Grande aims to prevent future violations of her privacy and safeguard her artistic work, asserting her right to control how her creations are disclosed to the public.
